scientific_integrity: Unrestricted claims follow from a rank-and-Jordan proof. Two executable finite checks are corroborating evidence, not an infinite proof. The generic reversible second-order construction and the ordinary Johnson-graph definition are credited as prior knowledge. No external mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to triangular Johnson graphs, the specified reversible two-time-level neighbor-sum rule, and characteristic-three finite fields. The formulas count labelled configurations and do not classify nonlinear rules or different field characteristics. A finite literature search cannot exclude unindexed equivalent modular orbit calculations. Independent mathematical validation remains unperformed.
title: A modulo-three Jordan resonance and exact wave clocks on triangular Johnson graphs
